name: Mandatum Oyj
summary: Mandatum Oyj operates as a financial services provider in Finland. The company delivers a comprehensive range of solutions, including asset and wealth stewardship, investment and savings offerings, compensation and rewards programs, as well as retirement planning and personal protection insurance. Its clientele is diverse, encompassing corporations, individual consumers, institutions, and high-net-worth individuals seeking specialized wealth management. Mandatum Oyj was established in 1874 and maintains its principal office in Helsinki, Finland.
